description: Check whether a cited paper really exists (catch hallucinated or mistyped references) and whether it has been retracted. Give a doi, or a title with optional year and first_author. Returns exists, verdict (verified | found | doi_exists_metadata_mismatch | uncertain | not_found), confidence (high/medium/low) with a note on what matched, is_retracted (OpenAlex is_retracted + Crossref/Retraction Watch notices) and the best match. Data: OpenAlex (CC0, openalex.org) with Crossref REST (crossref.org) for retraction notices and as fallback. Upstream errors are not charged. Costs $0.002 USDC per check via x402.

doi.description: DOI of the cited work (preferred if known)

first_author.description: First author's name or surname as cited (optional)

title.description: Title of the cited work (used when no DOI is given; also cross-checked against a DOI)

name: check_citation
